name: Tranche
definition: One of a number of related assets offered as part of the same transaction. The detachment point less the attachment  point represents the maximum loss.

DetachmentPoint.name: Detachment Point
DetachmentPoint.definition: Point beyond which losses do not affect the tranche.

AttachmentPoint.name: Attachment Point
AttachmentPoint.definition: The attachment point defines the amount of subordination a tranche enjoys.

Asset.name: Asset
Asset.definition: Specifies the asset for which tranche information is reported.
